notes.title: Barty's Adventure Demo v1.0.5 Now Live
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45437788/70bf4f6ec02d7bb5926db81d5fa2bf4a89f0c2bb.png"][/img][/p][p]Well, it didn't take long to have to fix a few things in the demo. But after this, some of the main feature should provide a much smoother experience! Check out the patch notes below for updates and fixes:

[b][u]UPDATES[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted Barty's swing animation so that the rattle attacks are snappier. Also reworked the animation code so that his attack animations don't overwrite themselves if you spam the attack button.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]FIXES[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Barty's collision so that you can't get stuck on corners and walls while jumping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that continuously played a noise when Discord opened from the menu (sorry, eardrums!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the spelling of "remapping"[/p][/*][*][p]Confirm Settings on the remapping menu now pulses if you highlight it.[/p][/*][*][p]Got rid of a rectangle symbol in Luppy's dialogue after you bubble him and loop. No this was not an ARG.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Toddy's Bubble attack can result in Barty halfway in the floor. [/p][/*][*][p]Ava Cado's dialogue can freeze when you first talk to her.[/p][/*][*][p]Costumes remain in inventory if you wear them looping back, even if you didn't keep the required items.[/p][/*][*][p]Costumes appear floating sometimes when in "button shooting" mode[/p][/*][*][p]Costumes appear on the wrong layer when Barty enters a room from the bottom while wearing one.[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting the remap menu immediately enters you into the full screen adjustment.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There will definitely be more fixes on the way, but hopefully these weren't too game-breaking for you so far. Enjoy exploring the world![/p][p]-Sebastian[/p]

notes.title: The Barty's Adventure Demo is Here!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45437788/8e31b6055d52929273969237b4e726dc9a84cfbe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][u]The countdown is over![/u][/i][/b] The official Barty's Adventure demo is here! In this fun-sized portion of the full game, players will be able to experience much that the adventure has to offer. From finding lost puppies, meeting unusual toys, and discovering secret parts of the House, there's more than enough for everyone in this demo.[/p][p][/p][p]Try it out here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897780/Bartys_Adventure_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The nitty gritty details are below, but I wanted to say up front that I hope you enjoy and have fun with the world and story I built! [b][i][u]Thank you[/u][/i][/b] for checking it out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45437788/6faf8ffec3c56171e72cf8f61c83be3cd9ff7dd7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In this demo of the full game, you'll get a chance to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Master[/b] the time loop by choosing exactly when Barty returns to the morning of his first day in the House.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explore[/b] the first two sections of The House: Stuffie's Town and the Kitchen. Find secrets, collectables, and new friends around every corner![/p][/*][*][p][b]Execute[/b] strategic decisions as to who or what is not reset with the change in time. This includes NPCs memories and relationships, collectables gained, and powerups discovered.[/p][/*][*][p][b]End[/b] the three day cycle on your own terms, whenever you think Barty has done enough to prepare for the oncoming Colic. Your preparations and discoveries will dictate what the future holds for the toys in the House in one of three possible endings for the demo![/p][/*][*][p][b]Meet[/b] and get to know dozens NPCs in the demo alone, each with their own personality, and trackable likes and dislikes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maintain[/b] Barty's relationship with every single toy in the demo, and choose whether to save that relationship in the time loop or reset it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Romance[/b] one of the twelve Old Toys, Ava Cado. If you wish, you can gain her trust and provide her with comfort throughout the trying three days. Be careful though! A negative relationship with her has its consequences! Barty will soon find himself in the middle of a boss fight if he doesn't mind his manners![/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] through hoards of hostile Rottens, food that has gone bad in the Kitchen. The demo also includes four of the 40 boss battles from the full game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Harness[/b] the abilities of three kid-tested, parent-approved powerups. Barty will need them all in order to save the day![/p][/*][*][p][b]Collect[/b] a whole bunch of other helpful items as well, such as storybook pages, puzzle pieces, and letter blocks![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2025 Days of Ramadan Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45437788/afc482b1abdacdc7da2a96807473b3b991374356.png[/img]

I'm excited to announce that [i]Barty's Adventure[/i] has been selected to be a part of the Days of Ramadan festival on Steam! This is a huge honor for me, as it happens to be the game's very first Steam Fest. The festival highlights games made by Southeast Asian devs, so give it a look and support some amazing teams:

[b]FESTIVAL HERE:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/RamadanFestival2025

The Barty demo is still a couple of months away, but you can still wishlist the game directly from the store page. And don't forget to keep checking in for more info!

Thanks and talk to you soon! ːsteamhappyː
- Sebastian
